doc_20250925_145858.translated_text: Haci lady! + I wish myself all the best for your short trip. Thank you very much for everything. Unfortunately, various outsiders didn't want us to see each other before your trip. Nevertheless, I will try to do some productive work for you. 7th evening. Yours, Bob. And so I got the approval for the Flux card. If I have Peats, haugh & apart from that I will have Peatz. So I'll definitely come with Pempten. By the way, Rob. P. 1.38 Zabūs, andlish your letter arrived yesterday evening. However, I can't understand why the 10 tapes didn't get in the mail. Besides, I always wrote immediately when I knew something definitive. = Little one, I won't moan anymore, but if this continues, I'm ripe for a Verven sanatorium. It's a shame that so much valuable material is being lost. The three-day journey didn't bother me at all. I also need three more visas for Hungary, Yugoslavia and Switzerland. The Ingosta visa was rejected yesterday and I have to submit it to Belgrade and that's taking time. In my desperation I called the Foreign Ministry again. Dr. From called today. I was told that I had come back. I went there straight away, spoke to his representative, had a conversation over the phone and now I'm sitting down in the Foreign Ministry and waiting for the letter they sent me for the National Bank. So I'll give it one more try and get the flight ticket approved! You won't be able to find out in the whole of the two until I tell you everything in person. It couldn't be more complicated. What you know is at most 10% of it. I make it my own. The Verven. version versagu Do you know how happy I would be if I had already put everything in my mind?!!! You can be sure that I'm doing everything. Of course I've made mistakes too, but if you write everything down beforehand, - personally. About that and at Troc at From, of course, the telegram that I sent about my visit today was sent through the letter. Little one, please don't be patient, I'm already tired of it. His Zob.

doc_20250927_100809.title: 049-1940-05-16-fre - 2025-09-27
doc_20250927_100809.original_text: My darling, May 16, 1940 Very quickly, just a few lines. We are all very well, a little nervous, but it's nothing. I am at work all day and come home early so that Mom is alone as little as possible. Write to me every day without fail, it's more important than ever, you know now. K... Tell me also how you are, if you are staying where you are or if you are going somewhere else. I don't have the heart and the courage to look for the films you are asking me for now/ Maybe in a few days. Goodbye my love, good luck, we have plenty! I love you infinitely. Baby.
